toefl:se:352.answer: Unfortunately, I have a prior family commitment on the same evening, which I am unable to reschedule.
toefl:se:352.fullSentence: Unfortunately, I have a prior family commitment on the same evening, which I am unable to reschedule.
keyPhrases: prior family commitment
unable to reschedule
toefl:se:352.japanese: 残念ながら、同じ夜に変更のできない前々からの家族の用事があります。
toefl:se:352.explanation: prior commitmentで「以前からの約束」を表す。
toefl:se:352.relatedInfo: a pre-existing family obligation / a commitment I can't move

toefl:se:353.answer: My family is hosting a reunion, and it's been planned for months, so it's important for me to attend.
toefl:se:353.fullSentence: My family is hosting a reunion, and it's been planned for months, so it's important for me to attend.
keyPhrases: hosting a reunion
planned for months
toefl:se:353.japanese: 私の家族が同窓会を主催しており、それは何か月も前から計画されていたため、出席することが私にとって重要です。
toefl:se:353.explanation: has been plannedは現在完了受動態で継続的な準備を表す。
toefl:se:353.relatedInfo: organized months in advance / arranged well ahead of time

toefl:se:354.answer: I'm really sorry that I won't be able to be there on your special day, as I was really looking forward to celebrating with you.
toefl:se:354.fullSentence: I'm really sorry that I won't be able to be there on your special day, as I was really looking forward to celebrating with you.
keyPhrases: really sorry that i won't be able to be there
really looking forward to celebrating with you
toefl:se:354.japanese: あなたと一緒にお祝いするのを本当に楽しみにしていたので、あなたの特別な日にそこにいられないことを本当に申し訳なく思います。
toefl:se:354.explanation: as以下は理由を表す接続詞節。
toefl:se:354.relatedInfo: truly sorry to miss your day / had really been looking forward to it

toefl:se:355.answer: However, I would love the opportunity to celebrate together at another time.
toefl:se:355.fullSentence: However, I would love the opportunity to celebrate together at another time.
keyPhrases: love the opportunity to celebrate together at another time
toefl:se:355.japanese: でも、別の機会に一緒にお祝いできればと心から思います。
toefl:se:355.explanation: the opportunity to doで「〜する機会」を表す。
toefl:se:355.relatedInfo: hope for a chance to celebrate later / would welcome another time to celebrate

toefl:se:356.answer: How about we meet for lunch or dinner sometime next week?
toefl:se:356.fullSentence: How about we meet for lunch or dinner sometime next week?
keyPhrases: meet for lunch or dinner
sometime next week
toefl:se:356.japanese: 来週のどこかでランチかディナーをご一緒するのはいかがでしょうか。
toefl:se:356.explanation: How about we〜?は丁寧な提案を表す口語表現。
toefl:se:356.relatedInfo: grab lunch together / get dinner sometime soon

toefl:se:357.answer: It would be a great chance for us to catch up and for me to properly celebrate your birthday.
toefl:se:357.fullSentence: It would be a great chance for us to catch up and for me to properly celebrate your birthday.
keyPhrases: great chance for us to catch up
properly celebrate your birthday
toefl:se:357.japanese: 近況を語り合い、あなたの誕生日をきちんとお祝いする良い機会になると思います。
toefl:se:357.explanation: properlyは「きちんと、正式に」という副詞。
toefl:se:357.relatedInfo: a good opportunity to catch up / a proper celebration this time

toefl:se:358.answer: Please let me know what works for you.
toefl:se:358.fullSentence: Please let me know what works for you.
keyPhrases: let me know what works for you
toefl:se:358.japanese: 都合の良い方法を教えてください。
toefl:se:358.explanation: what works for youは日程調整の定型表現。
toefl:se:358.relatedInfo: let me know your preference / tell me what suits you

toefl:se:359.answer: I hope you have a fantastic birthday dinner and I'm looking forward to hearing all about it soon.
toefl:se:359.fullSentence: I hope you have a fantastic birthday dinner and I'm looking forward to hearing all about it soon.
keyPhrases: hope you have a fantastic birthday dinner
looking forward to hearing all about it soon
toefl:se:359.japanese: 素晴らしい誕生日ディナーになりますように。詳しいお話を聞くのを楽しみにしています。
toefl:se:359.explanation: 結びの祝福＋今後への期待の定型表現。
toefl:se:359.relatedInfo: wishing you a wonderful dinner / can't wait to hear how it went

keyPhrases: dear emma
toefl:se:360.explanation: 個人宛メールの書き出し。

keyPhrases: i hope you're doing well
toefl:se:361.japanese: お元気でお過ごしのことと思います。
toefl:se:361.explanation: カジュアルな挨拶表現。
toefl:se:361.relatedInfo: Hope you're doing great. / I hope all is well.

toefl:se:362.answer: I wanted to let you know that, unfortunately, I won't be able to attend your birthday celebration.
toefl:se:362.fullSentence: I wanted to let you know that, unfortunately, I won't be able to attend your birthday celebration.
keyPhrases: won't be able to attend your birthday celebration
toefl:se:362.japanese: 残念ながらあなたの誕生日のお祝いに出席できなくなったことをお伝えしたく思います。
toefl:se:362.explanation: I wanted to let you knowは知らせを伝える丁寧な前置き表現。
toefl:se:362.relatedInfo: can't make it to your celebration / have to miss your birthday event

toefl:se:363.answer: I just found out that I need to travel for work on that day, and I'm really disappointed about having to miss such a special occasion.
toefl:se:363.fullSentence: I just found out that I need to travel for work on that day, and I'm really disappointed about having to miss such a special occasion.
keyPhrases: need to travel for work
really disappointed about having to miss such a special occasion
toefl:se:363.japanese: その日は仕事で出張しなければならないことが分かり、そのような特別な機会を逃さなければならないことをとても残念に思います。
toefl:se:363.explanation: have to miss〜で「〜を逃さなければならない」を表す。
toefl:se:363.relatedInfo: a business trip came up / really hate having to miss it

toefl:se:364.answer: I was truly looking forward to celebrating with you and catching up.
toefl:se:364.fullSentence: I was truly looking forward to celebrating with you and catching up.
keyPhrases: truly looking forward to celebrating with you
catching up
toefl:se:364.japanese: あなたと一緒にお祝いし、近況を語り合うのを心から楽しみにしていました。
toefl:se:364.explanation: trulyで「心から」と気持ちを強調する副詞。
toefl:se:364.relatedInfo: had really been excited to celebrate / genuinely looking forward to it

toefl:se:365.answer: I always enjoy celebrating together, so I feel bad about having to change my plans.
toefl:se:365.fullSentence: I always enjoy celebrating together, so I feel bad about having to change my plans.
keyPhrases: always enjoy celebrating together
feel bad about having to change my plans
toefl:se:365.japanese: いつも一緒にお祝いするのを楽しんでいるので、予定を変えなければならないことを申し訳なく思います。
toefl:se:365.explanation: feel bad about -ingで「〜することを申し訳なく思う」を表す。
toefl:se:365.relatedInfo: hate having to change plans / feel guilty about the change

toefl:se:366.answer: I'll definitely be thinking of you even though I can't be there.
toefl:se:366.fullSentence: I'll definitely be thinking of you even though I can't be there.
keyPhrases: definitely be thinking of you
even though i can't be there
toefl:se:366.japanese: そこにいられなくても、必ずあなたのことを想っています。
toefl:se:366.explanation: even though〜は「〜だけれども」という譲歩の接続詞。
toefl:se:366.relatedInfo: will be thinking of you all day / you'll be on my mind

toefl:se:367.answer: However, I would love to make it up to you by arranging another day for us to celebrate together.
toefl:se:367.fullSentence: However, I would love to make it up to you by arranging another day for us to celebrate together.
keyPhrases: love to make it up to you
arranging another day for us to celebrate together
toefl:se:367.japanese: でも、別の日を設けて一緒にお祝いすることで埋め合わせをしたいと心から思います。
toefl:se:367.explanation: by -ingで「〜することによって」と手段を示す。
toefl:se:367.relatedInfo: want to make up for it / hope to set up another celebration

toefl:se:368.answer: How about getting together next weekend for brunch or dinner?
toefl:se:368.fullSentence: How about getting together next weekend for brunch or dinner?
keyPhrases: getting together next weekend
brunch or dinner
toefl:se:368.japanese: 来週末にブランチかディナーで集まるのはいかがでしょうか。
toefl:se:368.explanation: get togetherは「集まる」というカジュアルな表現。
toefl:se:368.relatedInfo: meet up next weekend / catch up over brunch

toefl:se:369.answer: We could pick a place you love and have a small celebration, just the two of us.
toefl:se:369.fullSentence: We could pick a place you love and have a small celebration, just the two of us.
keyPhrases: pick a place you love
small celebration, just the two of us
toefl:se:369.japanese: あなたが好きな場所を選んで、私たち二人だけでささやかなお祝いをしましょう。
toefl:se:369.explanation: just the two of usで「私たち二人だけで」を表す。
toefl:se:369.relatedInfo: choose your favorite spot / a low-key celebration just for us

toefl:se:370.answer: Let me know what works for you, and we'll make sure to have a wonderful time.
toefl:se:370.fullSentence: Let me know what works for you, and we'll make sure to have a wonderful time.
keyPhrases: let me know what works for you
make sure to have a wonderful time
toefl:se:370.japanese: 都合の良い方法を教えてください。素敵な時間になるようにしましょう。
toefl:se:370.explanation: make sure to doで「必ず〜するようにする」を表す。
toefl:se:370.relatedInfo: tell me what suits you / we'll have a great time together

toefl:se:371.answer: Looking forward to celebrating with you soon!
toefl:se:371.fullSentence: Looking forward to celebrating with you soon!
keyPhrases: looking forward to celebrating with you soon
toefl:se:371.japanese: 近いうちに一緒にお祝いできるのを楽しみにしています！
toefl:se:371.explanation: 結びの定型表現。主語省略のカジュアルな形。
toefl:se:371.relatedInfo: can't wait to celebrate together / excited for our celebration soon

keyPhrases: dear emma
toefl:se:372.explanation: 個人宛メールの書き出し。

toefl:se:373.answer: I hope this mail finds you well.
toefl:se:373.fullSentence: I hope this mail finds you well.
keyPhrases: i hope this mail finds you well
toefl:se:373.japanese: このメールが良い状態で届いていることを願っています。
toefl:se:373.explanation: 定型の挨拶表現。mailはemailのカジュアルな言い換え。
toefl:se:373.relatedInfo: I hope this email finds you well. / I hope you're doing well.

toefl:se:374.answer: I am really sorry, but I won't be able to attend your birthday celebration because I have to travel for work on that day, and unfortunately, I cannot change my schedule.
toefl:se:374.fullSentence: I am really sorry, but I won't be able to attend your birthday celebration because I have to travel for work on that day, and unfortunately, I cannot change my schedule.
keyPhrases: really sorry
travel for work
cannot change my schedule
toefl:se:374.japanese: 本当に申し訳ないのですが、その日は仕事で出張しなければならず、残念ながらスケジュールを変更できないため、あなたの誕生日のお祝いに出席できません。
toefl:se:374.explanation: cannot change my scheduleで「予定を変更できない」を表す。
toefl:se:374.relatedInfo: can't rearrange my schedule / a work trip that can't be moved

toefl:se:375.answer: I feel very disappointed to miss out on your special day and was really looking forward to celebrating with you.
toefl:se:375.fullSentence: I feel very disappointed to miss out on your special day and was really looking forward to celebrating with you.
keyPhrases: feel very disappointed to miss out
really looking forward to celebrating with you
toefl:se:375.japanese: あなたの特別な日を逃すことをとても残念に思いますし、一緒にお祝いするのを本当に楽しみにしていました。
toefl:se:375.explanation: miss out onで「〜を逃す」という表現。
toefl:se:375.relatedInfo: gutted to miss your special day / had really been excited for it

toefl:se:376.answer: Since I don't want to miss the chance to celebrate together, I would love to meet up on another day instead.
toefl:se:376.fullSentence: Since I don't want to miss the chance to celebrate together, I would love to meet up on another day instead.
keyPhrases: don't want to miss the chance to celebrate together
meet up on another day instead
toefl:se:376.japanese: 一緒にお祝いする機会を逃したくないので、代わりに別の日にお会いしたいです。
toefl:se:376.explanation: Sinceは「〜なので」という理由を表す接続詞。
toefl:se:376.relatedInfo: don't want to skip celebrating altogether / would rather meet another day
